verdict.rationale: EFTPS is a federal tax payment web portal and voice-response system, not an AI agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in other servers' tools is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any AI or tool-consuming capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
